Hi Aisha — thanks for sending this over. Below are concise answers for the hosted API offering; I included the evidence bundle and a short FAQ as attachments. Happy to follow up on a call if you want more detail.

High-level summary
- Hosted API default region: US (primary deployment in us-west-2, with multi-AZ replication for availability).
- EU geofencing: available by contract (EU-hosted region deployment) — requires an addendum and ~3–4 week provisioning lead time.

Retention & storage (hosted API)
- Request/Response payloads (inputs & generated outputs): retained by default for 30 days. These are used for abuse detection, quality monitoring, and short-term troubleshooting. Customers may request shorter retention where contractually agreed.
- Telemetry & access logs (API request metadata, auth logs, error traces): retained for 90 days for operational and security investigations; aggregated usage metrics retained 13 months for billing/forecasting.
- Billing & invoicing records: retained for 90 days in active systems; transactional archives stored for up to 7 years for accounting/legal where required (access restricted to finance).

Deletion process & SLA
- Customer-initiated deletion: customers can request complete deletion of their tenant data via Support ticket or the self-serve deletion API endpoint (documented in the customer console).
- Primary store deletion SLA: Redwood commits to removing active copies within 72 hours of a validated deletion request for hosted API customers under standard terms.
- Backups & DR copies: rolling encrypted snapshots are retained for 7 days by default. For disaster-recovery archives and billing snapshots, a further retention of up to 30 days may apply. Deletion from backups occurs during the next snapshot retention cycle and can take up to 30 days to fully eliminate data from archival systems.

Backups & encryption
- Snapshots: incremental, encrypted (AES-256) snapshots taken daily; rolling 7-day snapshot window for operational recovery.
- Transport: TLS 1.2+ in transit.
- At-rest: AES-256; access limited to authorized infra services and audited personnel.
- Key management: Redwood manages KMS keys for hosted customers; customer-managed keys (BYOK) are available for Dedicated and Private deployments.

Evidence & compliance
- Attestations: SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA; Data Processing Addendum (DPA) is available and can be appended to the Master Services Agreement.
- Evidence bundle: attached is a manifest and sanitized examples ("evidence-bundle-manifest.csv" and "evergreen-sq-evidence.zip").

Notes / exceptions
- Dedicated capacity customers have greater control over retention and can configure longer or shorter windows via the Dedicated admin console; Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) are fully customer-controlled for data residency and key management.
- Emergency holds for legal/incident response are possible but will be handled under our legal process and documented in the DPA.

Attachments: evergreen-sq-answers.pdf (summary), evidence-bundle-manifest.csv (CSV), evergreen-sq-evidence.zip (ZIP, manifest & limited sample artifacts)

If you'd like, I can schedule a 20-min technical sync with Ben (security solutions) and Marissa (compliance) to walk through the backup lifecycle and DPA language.

Subject: Internal: wording nit on backup retention (Evergreen thread)

Priya / Ben — quick internal note before we send to Aisha/Tom: please tweak the backup wording to avoid implying backups are "instantaneously" purged. Suggestion below:

Proposed updated language (for external):
- "Operational snapshots are incremental and retained on a rolling 7-day window for recovery. Point-in-time archival snapshots used for billing/financial reconciliation are retained up to 30 days. Full disaster-recovery archives (used only for DR scenarios) are encrypted and retained for up to 30 days before secure deletion. Deletion from backups occurs as part of the normal retention lifecycle and can take up to 30 days to complete."

Also include a short line about immutable logs for security investigations (retained 90 days) and that any longer retention for legal/accounting requires a signed addendum. I updated the evidence manifest (attached) with sample redaction notes.

Marissa
